d:
Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath puja ke pavan avsar par rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke pramukh lalu prasad yadav ne pradesh aur deshvasiyon ko hardik shubhkamnaen di hain. chhath parv ko lekar apni bhavnaen vyakt karte hue lalu yadav ne sabhi logon se pure utsah aur dhumdham ke sath is mahaparv ko manane ki apil ki hai.
About Channel:
ABP Bihar pradesh ki khabron ka ek aisa chainal hai jahan pradesh se juri har khabar aapke pas sabse pahle pahunchti hai. bihar ki rajniti, bihar ki barh, lalu - nitish ka ek dusre par palatvar, apradh ki andruni khabar aapke pas tathyon ke sath lekar aata hai.
